content: Hybrid relational+JSONB is the durable default for SaaS question banks: typed columns for fields present in every row and queried/aggregated (id, institute_id, scope FKs, type, difficulty, approval, source, timestamps); JSONB payload for type-specific varying shape (MCQ choices+correct choice, TF answer, FITB acceptable answers). Matches CatLium content_items/content_versions pattern.
